easy: A set of steps for going up and down.

ex.en: We raced up the stairway to the second floor.
ex.ko: 우리는 계단을 뛰어 2층으로 올라갔다.

easy: Full of stars, or shining like stars.

ex.en: We lay on the grass and looked at the starry night sky.
ex.ko: 우리는 풀밭에 누워 별이 총총한 밤하늘을 보았다.

easy: Having to do with the Stoics, old Greek thinkers who taught people to stay calm when life is hard.

ex.en: Our teacher shared a Stoic saying about staying calm.
ex.ko: 선생님은 침착함에 관한 스토아학파의 말을 들려주셨다.

easy: A follower of an old Greek way of thinking that teaches people to stay calm and accept what happens.

ex.en: A Stoic tries to stay calm even when bad things happen.
ex.ko: 스토아학파 사람은 나쁜 일이 생겨도 침착하려고 애쓴다.

easy: Faster than the speed of sound.

ex.en: The supersonic jet made a loud boom as it flew by.
ex.ko: 초음속 제트기가 지나가면서 큰 굉음을 냈다.

easy: By using technology, like machines and computers.

ex.en: Robots that clean your room are technologically possible now.
ex.ko: 방을 청소하는 로봇은 이제 기술적으로 가능하다.

easy: Not doing or having too much of anything.

ex.en: Grandpa says temperance means one cookie is enough.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 절제란 쿠키 하나로 만족하는 것이라고 하신다.

easy: Stopped from doing what you hoped to do.

ex.en: His thwarted plan to build a snow fort made him grumpy.
ex.ko: 눈 요새를 지으려던 계획이 틀어져서 그는 뾰로통해졌다.

easy: A stone that marks where someone is buried.

ex.en: Grandpa's tombstone has his name and a little flower carved on it.
ex.ko: 할아버지 묘비에는 이름과 작은 꽃이 새겨져 있다.

easy: Not held back or controlled.

ex.en: Unchecked weeds took over the whole garden.
ex.ko: 내버려 둔 잡초가 정원 전체를 뒤덮었다.

easy: So unlikely that you can hardly even picture it.

ex.en: A snow day in July is unimaginable in Texas.
ex.ko: 텍사스에서 7월에 눈 때문에 학교를 쉬는 건 상상할 수도 없다.

easy: Like a perfect, dream world where everything is good.

ex.en: The book describes a utopian town where everyone is kind.
ex.ko: 그 책은 모두가 친절한 이상향 같은 마을을 그린다.

easy: A person who dreams of a perfect world, even if it is hard to make real.

ex.en: The utopian dreamed of a city with no fighting at all.
ex.ko: 그 이상주의자는 싸움이 전혀 없는 도시를 꿈꾸었다.

easy: With all your heart, without holding anything back.

ex.en: I wholeheartedly agree that we should get a cat.
ex.ko: 고양이를 키워야 한다는 데 나는 진심으로 찬성한다.

easy: The point in the sky straight above your head.

ex.en: At noon, the sun was almost at the zenith.
ex.ko: 정오에 해가 거의 머리 바로 위에 있었다.

easy: Not the same on both sides.

ex.en: Her art project was an asymmetric design with a big circle on one side.
ex.ko: 그녀의 미술 작품은 한쪽에만 큰 원이 있는 비대칭 디자인이었다.

easy: About the writer's own life.

ex.en: The author's book is autobiographical; it's about her own childhood.
ex.ko: 그 작가의 책은 자전적이다. 자기 어린 시절에 관한 이야기다.

easy: Having to do with birds.

ex.en: Avian flu is a sickness that birds can catch.
ex.ko: 조류 독감은 새가 걸리는 병이다.

easy: A slow, swampy stream or river in the southern US, like in Louisiana.

ex.en: We saw an alligator floating in the bayou.
ex.ko: 우리는 늪 같은 샛강에 떠 있는 악어를 보았다.

easy: Exercise that makes your muscles big and strong.

ex.en: My uncle lifts weights every day for bodybuilding.
ex.ko: 삼촌은 보디빌딩을 위해 매일 역기를 든다.

easy: A person who leads the singing of a choir.

ex.en: The cantor led the choir in a beautiful song.
ex.ko: 성가대 지휘자가 합창단을 이끌어 아름다운 노래를 불렀다.

easy: A set of tuned bells that you hit with a hammer to play music.

ex.en: The chimes rang out at the end of the concert.
ex.ko: 음악회가 끝날 때 차임 소리가 울려 퍼졌다.

easy: To ring like a bell.

ex.en: The clock chimed twelve times at noon.
ex.ko: 정오에 시계가 열두 번 울렸다.

easy: A warm feeling of being close and belonging together.

ex.en: The closeness between the two sisters made them best friends.
ex.ko: 두 자매는 아주 가까워서 가장 친한 친구가 되었다.

easy: A thing people like to collect, like cards or toys.

ex.en: My brother keeps his baseball card collectibles in a binder.
ex.ko: 형은 야구 카드 수집품을 바인더에 보관한다.

easy: How well something lets heat or electricity pass through it.

ex.en: Copper has high conductivity, so it carries electricity well.
ex.ko: 구리는 전도성이 높아서 전기가 잘 통한다.

easy: Having to do with the words or situation around something.

ex.en: Contextual clues help you guess what a new word means.
ex.ko: 문맥 단서는 새 단어의 뜻을 짐작하는 데 도움이 된다.

easy: A line of police or guards around a place to keep people out.

ex.en: Police set up a cordon around the burning building.
ex.ko: 경찰이 불타는 건물 주위에 저지선을 쳤다.

easy: A puzzle where you fill in words in rows of squares using clues.

ex.en: Grandpa does the crossword in the newspaper every morning.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 매일 아침 신문의 십자말풀이를 푸신다.

easy: So soft and cute that you want to hug it.

ex.en: The cuddly kitten curled up in my lap.
ex.ko: 껴안고 싶을 만큼 귀여운 새끼 고양이가 내 무릎에서 몸을 웅크렸다.

easy: To figure out a secret code or something hard to read.

ex.en: We deciphered the secret message using the code wheel.
ex.ko: 우리는 암호 바퀴로 비밀 메시지를 해독했다.

easy: When something is used up until very little is left.

ex.en: Using too much water can lead to the depletion of the lake.
ex.ko: 물을 너무 많이 쓰면 호수가 말라 버릴 수 있다.

easy: Spreading things out in many directions.

ex.en: Wind helps the dispersal of dandelion seeds.
ex.ko: 바람은 민들레 씨앗이 흩어지는 것을 돕는다.

easy: A feeling of being unhappy or annoyed about something.

ex.en: The cat showed its displeasure by flicking its tail.
ex.ko: 고양이는 꼬리를 탁탁 치며 불만을 드러냈다.

easy: So easy that it seems to take no work at all.

ex.en: The swan glided across the pond in an effortless way.
ex.ko: 백조는 아무 힘도 들이지 않는 듯 연못 위를 미끄러져 갔다.

easy: Colored makeup put on the eyelids.

ex.en: Mom wore sparkly eyeshadow to the wedding.
ex.ko: 엄마는 결혼식에 반짝이는 아이섀도를 바르셨다.

easy: Good luck that happens by chance.

ex.en: My first basket from half-court was a total fluke.
ex.ko: 하프 코트에서 넣은 내 첫 골은 완전히 운이었다.

easy: A challenge to someone, as in 'throw down the gauntlet'.

ex.en: My sister threw down the gauntlet and dared me to a race.
ex.ko: 언니가 도전장을 던지며 나에게 달리기 시합을 하자고 했다.

easy: From Ghana, a country in West Africa, or having to do with its people.

ex.en: Ghanaian farmers grow lots of cocoa for chocolate.
ex.ko: 가나의 농부들은 초콜릿에 쓰이는 카카오를 많이 재배한다.

easy: A person from Ghana, a country in West Africa.

ex.en: Our new classmate is a Ghanaian who loves soccer.
ex.ko: 새로 온 반 친구는 축구를 좋아하는 가나 사람이다.

easy: A cover made of metal bars that lets air or water through.

ex.en: My coin fell through the grating on the sidewalk.
ex.ko: 내 동전이 보도의 쇠창살 틈으로 떨어졌다.

easy: Harsh and unpleasant to hear.

ex.en: The old gate made a grating noise when it opened.
ex.ko: 낡은 대문이 열릴 때 귀에 거슬리는 소리가 났다.

easy: The meat of a grouse, a wild bird, cooked as food.

ex.en: The hunters roasted grouse over the fire.
ex.ko: 사냥꾼들은 불 위에 뇌조 고기를 구웠다.

easy: A low, rough sound, like an angry dog makes.

ex.en: We heard a growl from behind the fence.
ex.ko: 울타리 뒤에서 으르렁거리는 소리가 들렸다.

easy: To make a low, deep, rumbling sound.

ex.en: Thunder growled far away over the hills.
ex.ko: 언덕 너머 멀리서 천둥이 우르릉거렸다.

easy: Having to do with the Himalayas, the tallest mountains in the world.

ex.en: Climbers dream of reaching the Himalayan peaks.
ex.ko: 등반가들은 히말라야 봉우리에 오르기를 꿈꾼다.

easy: Having to do with growing plants, flowers, and gardens.

ex.en: Our class visited a horticultural show full of flowers.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 꽃이 가득한 원예 박람회에 갔다.

easy: Having to do with a country taking control of other lands.

ex.en: Our history book talks about imperialist wars long ago.
ex.ko: 우리 역사책은 옛날의 제국주의 전쟁에 대해 이야기한다.

easy: A person who believes a country should rule over other lands.

ex.en: The imperialist wanted his country to control more land.
ex.ko: 그 제국주의자는 자기 나라가 더 많은 땅을 다스리기를 원했다.

easy: Red, hot, and swollen, often from an infection.

ex.en: My finger was inflamed around the splinter.
ex.ko: 가시가 박힌 손가락 주위가 벌겋게 부어올랐다.

easy: Cruel and without kindness.

ex.en: Leaving a dog in a hot car is inhumane.
ex.ko: 강아지를 뜨거운 차 안에 두는 것은 잔인한 일이다.

easy: A style of letters that slant to the right.

ex.en: The book title was printed in italic.
ex.ko: 책 제목은 이탤릭체로 인쇄되어 있었다.

easy: Written in letters that slant to the right.

ex.en: Use italic letters for the names of books.
ex.ko: 책 이름에는 이탤릭체 글자를 써라.

easy: Not having a job.

ex.en: After the factory closed, many people were jobless.
ex.ko: 공장이 문을 닫은 뒤 많은 사람이 일자리를 잃었다.

easy: The study of laws and why courts decide things the way they do.

ex.en: My aunt studied jurisprudence in law school.
ex.ko: 이모는 로스쿨에서 법학을 공부했다.

easy: Having a good reason, so it can be called fair.

ex.en: Her anger was justifiable after her brother broke her toy.
ex.ko: 동생이 장난감을 망가뜨렸으니 그녀가 화난 것은 당연했다.

easy: A North American songbird with a yellow chest.

ex.en: A lark sang from the fence post in the field.
ex.ko: 들판의 울타리 기둥 위에서 들종다리가 노래했다.

easy: To play in a lively, happy way.

ex.en: The children larked about in the garden.
ex.ko: 아이들이 정원에서 신나게 뛰놀았다.

easy: A connection between things.

ex.en: Scientists found a linkage between sleep and good grades.
ex.ko: 과학자들은 잠과 좋은 성적 사이의 연관성을 찾아냈다.

easy: One of the thin slanted slats in a door or window that let air in but keep rain out.

ex.en: Air flowed in through the louvres on the closet door.
ex.ko: 옷장 문의 미늘살 사이로 바람이 들어왔다.

easy: Having to do with the Freemasons, a club of men with secret rituals.

ex.en: There is an old Masonic hall downtown.
ex.ko: 시내에 오래된 프리메이슨 회관이 있다.

easy: A trade deal between the US, Canada, and Mexico that made buying and selling across borders easier.

ex.en: NAFTA made it easier to sell goods between the three countries.
ex.ko: 북미자유무역협정 덕분에 세 나라 사이에 물건을 팔기가 쉬워졌다.

easy: Just found or just gotten.

ex.en: With his newfound courage, he jumped off the diving board.
ex.ko: 새로 생긴 용기로 그는 다이빙대에서 뛰어내렸다.

easy: The years from 1890 to 1899.

ex.en: My great-great-grandma was born in the nineties, way back in 1895.
ex.ko: 우리 고조할머니는 1890년대인 1895년에 태어나셨다.

easy: A person whose job is to look into people's complaints about the government.

ex.en: Dad wrote to the ombudsman about the broken streetlights.
ex.ko: 아빠는 고장 난 가로등에 대해 민원 조사관에게 편지를 썼다.

easy: A body part behind your stomach that helps digest food and controls sugar in your blood.

ex.en: The pancreas makes insulin to control sugar in your blood.
ex.ko: 췌장은 피 속의 당을 조절하는 인슐린을 만든다.

easy: The person in charge of a post office.

ex.en: The postmaster put up a sign about the holiday hours.
ex.ko: 우체국장이 휴일 영업시간 안내문을 붙였다.

easy: The round of a tournament before the semifinals, with the last eight players or teams.

ex.en: Our team won the quarterfinal and moved on to the semifinals.
ex.ko: 우리 팀은 8강전에서 이겨 준결승에 올라갔다.

easy: A dried grape.

ex.en: I like raisins in my oatmeal.
ex.ko: 나는 오트밀에 건포도를 넣어 먹는 걸 좋아한다.

easy: Making an agreement official by formally approving it.

ex.en: The ratification of the treaty ended the war.
ex.ko: 그 조약이 비준되면서 전쟁이 끝났다.

easy: To prove that what someone said is wrong.

ex.en: She refuted his claim by showing the real test score.
ex.ko: 그녀는 진짜 시험 점수를 보여 주며 그의 주장을 반박했다.

easy: Moving people to a new place to live, often after trouble at home.

ex.en: The families started a new life after their resettlement in a new country.
ex.ko: 그 가족들은 새 나라로 이주한 뒤 새 삶을 시작했다.

easy: Spending a lot of time sitting and not moving much.

ex.en: Playing video games all day is a sedentary habit.
ex.ko: 하루 종일 비디오 게임을 하는 것은 앉아만 있는 습관이다.

easy: A room where things like cars are shown to people who might buy them.

ex.en: We looked at shiny new cars in the showroom.
ex.ko: 우리는 전시실에서 반짝이는 새 차들을 구경했다.

easy: Going around to look at interesting places.

ex.en: We went sightseeing in Washington, D.C., last summer.
ex.ko: 우리는 지난여름 워싱턴 D.C.로 관광을 갔다.

easy: Magic that uses spells and evil spirits.

ex.en: In the fairy tale, the witch used sorcery to turn the prince into a frog.
ex.ko: 동화에서 마녀는 마법으로 왕자를 개구리로 만들었다.

easy: A body part near your stomach that helps fight germs and clean your blood.

ex.en: The spleen helps your body fight off germs.
ex.ko: 비장은 몸이 세균과 싸우는 것을 돕는다.

easy: The light that comes from the stars.

ex.en: We walked home by starlight.
ex.ko: 우리는 별빛을 받으며 집으로 걸어갔다.

easy: To bend your body forward and down.

ex.en: I stooped down to pick up the shiny coin.
ex.ko: 나는 반짝이는 동전을 주우려고 몸을 굽혔다.

easy: A way of standing or walking with your back and shoulders bent forward.

ex.en: Grandpa walks with a slight stoop.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 조금 구부정하게 걸으신다.

easy: Having to do with style, especially the way something is written.

ex.en: The author made stylistic changes to make the story funnier.
ex.ko: 작가는 이야기를 더 재미있게 하려고 문체를 바꾸었다.

easy: Believing in magic or luck instead of science, like thinking black cats are bad luck.

ex.en: My superstitious friend never walks under a ladder.
ex.ko: 미신을 믿는 내 친구는 절대 사다리 밑으로 지나가지 않는다.

easy: In a way that is not final yet and might change.

ex.en: We tentatively planned a picnic for Saturday.
ex.ko: 우리는 일단 토요일에 소풍을 가기로 계획했다.

easy: Three times.

ex.en: The rooster crowed thrice before the sun came up.
ex.ko: 해가 뜨기 전에 수탉이 세 번 울었다.

easy: Getting upset or hurt very easily.

ex.en: He is touchy about his new haircut, so don't tease him.
ex.ko: 그는 새로 자른 머리에 예민하니까 놀리지 마.

easy: A strong stretchy sheet held by springs on a frame, for jumping on.

ex.en: We bounced on the trampoline in the backyard.
ex.ko: 우리는 뒷마당 트램펄린에서 통통 뛰었다.

easy: To go onto someone's land without permission.

ex.en: The sign says not to trespass on the farm.
ex.ko: 표지판에 농장에 무단으로 들어가지 말라고 쓰여 있다.

easy: Going onto or using someone's property without permission, which breaks the law.

ex.en: The farmer put up a sign to stop trespass on his land.
ex.ko: 농부는 자기 땅에 무단으로 들어오지 못하게 표지판을 세웠다.

easy: To promise to pay for something.

ex.en: A local bank underwrote our school's field trip.
ex.ko: 동네 은행이 우리 학교 현장 학습 비용을 후원했다.

easy: Not planned ahead of time.

ex.en: Our unplanned stop at the beach turned out to be the best part of the trip.
ex.ko: 계획에 없이 해변에 들른 것이 여행에서 가장 좋은 일이 되었다.

easy: Not expecting that anything is going on.

ex.en: We jumped out and surprised our unsuspecting dad on his birthday.
ex.ko: 우리는 아빠 생신에 튀어나와 아무것도 모르던 아빠를 깜짝 놀라게 했다.

easy: Not wanted or not nice to get.

ex.en: A skunk was an unwelcome visitor at our campsite.
ex.ko: 스컹크는 우리 캠핑장의 반갑지 않은 손님이었다.

easy: From Yemen, a country in the Middle East, or having to do with its people.

ex.en: We saw photos of tall Yemeni houses made of mud bricks.
ex.ko: 우리는 진흙 벽돌로 지은 높은 예멘 집들의 사진을 보았다.

easy: A person from Yemen, a country in the Middle East.

ex.en: My dad's coworker is a Yemeni who makes great coffee.
ex.ko: 아빠의 직장 동료는 커피를 아주 잘 내리는 예멘 사람이다.

easy: In a sharp, very strong way.

ex.en: He was acutely aware that everyone was watching him.
ex.ko: 그는 모두가 자기를 보고 있다는 것을 아주 뚜렷이 느꼈다.

easy: Not wanting to be with or talk to other people.

ex.en: Our cat is antisocial and hides when guests come.
ex.ko: 우리 고양이는 낯을 가려서 손님이 오면 숨는다.

easy: A person born when the sun is in the star sign Aries, in late March or April.

ex.en: My brother is an Aries because his birthday is in April.
ex.ko: 우리 오빠는 생일이 4월이라서 양자리이다.

easy: Away from the right path or the right way.

ex.en: The lamb went astray from the rest of the flock.
ex.ko: 새끼 양이 무리에서 떨어져 길을 잃었다.

easy: Wearing a little band, usually around a bird's leg, so it can be identified.

ex.en: Scientists counted the banded birds that came back in spring.
ex.ko: 과학자들은 봄에 돌아온 가락지 단 새들을 세었다.

easy: A list of people who are not liked or not allowed.

ex.en: The shop put the rude customer on its blacklist.
ex.ko: 그 가게는 무례한 손님을 블랙리스트에 올렸다.

easy: To put someone on a list of people who are not allowed or trusted.

ex.en: The store blacklisted the man who kept stealing candy.
ex.ko: 가게는 계속 사탕을 훔친 남자를 블랙리스트에 올렸다.

easy: The boss in a company who is in charge of its money.

ex.en: The CFO checks how much money the company spends.
ex.ko: 최고 재무 책임자는 회사가 돈을 얼마나 쓰는지 확인한다.

easy: A person who is running after someone to catch them.

ex.en: In tag, the chaser has to touch someone to make them 'it'.
ex.ko: 술래잡기에서 술래는 누군가를 건드려야 술래를 넘길 수 있다.

easy: A dried, smoked jalapeno pepper used in cooking.

ex.en: Dad adds chipotle to the chili to make it smoky.
ex.ko: 아빠는 칠리에 치폴레를 넣어 훈제 향이 나게 하신다.

easy: A person who makes up dances.

ex.en: The choreographer taught us the steps for the school show.
ex.ko: 안무가가 학교 공연의 춤 동작을 가르쳐 주었다.

easy: Having every part that is needed, with nothing missing.

ex.en: The teacher checked our projects for completeness.
ex.ko: 선생님은 우리 과제가 빠진 것 없이 다 되었는지 확인하셨다.

easy: A person who looks after a building or hotel, handling mail and helping people coming in and out.

ex.en: The concierge gave us the mail when we came home.
ex.ko: 우리가 집에 오자 관리인이 우편물을 건네주었다.

easy: A feeling of not trusting that people are good or honest.

ex.en: His cynicism made him doubt that anyone would return his lost wallet.
ex.ko: 냉소적인 그는 누가 잃어버린 지갑을 돌려줄 거라고 믿지 않았다.

easy: To become dark or darker.

ex.en: The sky darkened before the storm.
ex.ko: 폭풍이 오기 전에 하늘이 어두워졌다.

easy: With careful, hard work.

ex.en: She diligently practiced the piano every day.
ex.ko: 그녀는 매일 부지런히 피아노를 연습했다.

easy: Money or things a bride brought to her husband's family when she married, in old times.

ex.en: In the old story, the princess's dowry was a chest of gold.
ex.ko: 옛이야기에서 공주의 지참금은 금이 가득 든 상자였다.

easy: Having two very different sides or parts.

ex.en: The story shows the duality of the hero, who is both brave and scared.
ex.ko: 그 이야기는 용감하면서도 겁이 많은 주인공의 이중성을 보여 준다.

easy: A house split into two homes that share a wall.

ex.en: My best friend lives in the other half of our duplex.
ex.ko: 내 단짝은 우리 연립 주택의 다른 한쪽에 산다.

easy: A short speech an actor gives to the audience at the end of a play.

ex.en: At the end of the play, the narrator spoke the epilogue.
ex.ko: 연극 마지막에 해설자가 끝맺는 말을 했다.

easy: A picture printed from a metal plate that has lines cut into it with acid.

ex.en: The museum had an old etching of a sailing ship.
ex.ko: 박물관에는 범선을 새긴 오래된 동판화가 있었다.

easy: To be a typical or good example of something.

ex.en: This painting exemplifies the artist's bright, happy colors.
ex.ko: 이 그림은 그 화가의 밝고 즐거운 색채를 잘 보여 주는 예이다.

easy: Destroying something completely so none is left.

ex.en: The extermination of the ants in our kitchen took a week.
ex.ko: 부엌의 개미를 다 없애는 데 일주일이 걸렸다.

easy: Floating on top of water without sinking.

ex.en: A life jacket helps with flotation in deep water.
ex.ko: 구명조끼는 깊은 물에서 몸이 뜨도록 돕는다.

easy: Good enough for people or animals to live in.
ko: 살 수 있는, 거주할 수 있는

ex.en: Scientists look for planets that might be habitable.
ex.ko: 과학자들은 생물이 살 수 있을지도 모르는 행성을 찾는다.

easy: When one country or group is the strongest and leads or controls others.

ex.en: The empire had hegemony over the whole region.
ex.ko: 그 제국은 지역 전체에 대한 패권을 쥐고 있었다.

easy: A huge, heavy animal with thick skin that lives in and near rivers in Africa.

ex.en: The hippo opened its giant mouth and yawned.
ex.ko: 하마가 거대한 입을 벌리고 하품을 했다.

easy: Having to do with hypnosis, a sleepy, dreamy state where a person follows suggestions.

ex.en: The doctor helped him relax into a hypnotic state.
ex.ko: 의사는 그가 긴장을 풀고 최면 상태에 들도록 도왔다.

easy: A medicine that helps people fall asleep.

ex.en: The doctor gave Grandpa a mild hypnotic to help him sleep.
ex.ko: 의사는 할아버지께 잠을 잘 주무시도록 순한 수면제를 주었다.

easy: Not doing anything.

ex.en: The team lost because of their inaction on defense.
ex.ko: 그 팀은 수비에서 아무것도 하지 않아서 졌다.

easy: Not settling a question; still leaving doubt.

ex.en: The test results were inconclusive, so the doctor ordered another one.
ex.ko: 검사 결과가 확실하지 않아서 의사는 검사를 한 번 더 하자고 했다.

easy: A warm box that keeps eggs or tiny babies at just the right temperature.

ex.en: Our class watched chicks hatch in the incubator.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 부화기에서 병아리가 깨어나는 것을 지켜보았다.

easy: Clumsy and not smooth, especially in the way something is said or written.

ex.en: His inept speech left the audience confused.
ex.ko: 그의 서투른 연설은 청중을 어리둥절하게 했다.

easy: Not able to be pulled apart.
ko: 분리할 수 없는, 떼어 놓을 수 없는

ex.en: The two magnets were stuck so tightly they seemed inseparable.
ex.ko: 두 자석이 너무 단단히 붙어서 떼어 놓을 수 없을 것 같았다.

easy: Going into a vein, often through a thin tube.

ex.en: The nurse gave the sick boy medicine through an intravenous tube.
ex.ko: 간호사는 아픈 소년에게 정맥 주사관으로 약을 넣어 주었다.

easy: A feeling of being close to someone because you are alike.

ex.en: I felt a kinship with the new girl because we both love dragons.
ex.ko: 새로 온 여자아이와 나는 둘 다 용을 좋아해서 친밀감을 느꼈다.

easy: A short way to write kilovolt, a unit equal to 1,000 volts.

ex.en: The big power lines carry hundreds of kV.
ex.ko: 큰 송전선에는 수백 킬로볼트의 전기가 흐른다.

easy: A kind of sugar found only in milk.

ex.en: My dad drinks milk without lactose because regular milk upsets his stomach.
ex.ko: 아빠는 보통 우유를 마시면 배가 아파서 유당 없는 우유를 드신다.

easy: A wide, flat muscle on each side of your back.

ex.en: Doing pull-ups makes your lats stronger.
ex.ko: 턱걸이를 하면 광배근이 튼튼해진다.

easy: Not strict; letting people get away with things.

ex.en: Our lenient babysitter let us stay up late.
ex.ko: 너그러운 베이비시터가 우리를 늦게까지 안 자게 해 주었다.

easy: When owners keep workers out of their workplace until the workers agree to their terms.

ex.en: During the lockout, the workers could not go into the factory.
ex.ko: 직장 폐쇄 동안 노동자들은 공장에 들어갈 수 없었다.

easy: An oily substance that makes parts slide smoothly.

ex.en: Dad put some lube on my squeaky bike chain.
ex.ko: 아빠가 삐걱거리는 내 자전거 체인에 윤활유를 발라 주셨다.

easy: To put oil on something so its parts move smoothly.

ex.en: We lubed the bike chain so it would stop squeaking.
ex.ko: 자전거 체인이 그만 삐걱거리도록 우리는 기름을 쳤다.

easy: Hiding something by covering it up.

ex.en: The masking of the fort with branches made it hard to find.
ex.ko: 나뭇가지로 요새를 가려서 찾기 어려웠다.

easy: A master's degree in art, writing, or another creative subject.

ex.en: My art teacher has an MFA in painting.
ex.ko: 우리 미술 선생님은 회화 전공 예술 석사 학위가 있으시다.

easy: A helping verb like 'can', 'will', or 'should'.

ex.en: 'Can' and 'should' are modal verbs.
ex.ko: 'can'과 'should'는 조동사이다.

easy: A style of art and writing that broke away from old styles in the early 1900s.

ex.en: The museum has a whole room about modernism.
ex.ko: 그 박물관에는 모더니즘을 다룬 방이 하나 통째로 있다.

easy: A person who talks with others to help them reach an agreement.

ex.en: Mom is a great negotiator when we argue over the TV.
ex.ko: 우리가 텔레비전 때문에 다툴 때 엄마는 훌륭한 협상가가 되신다.

easy: One of the two curved marks ( ) used around extra words.

ex.en: Put the extra note inside a parenthesis.
ex.ko: 덧붙이는 말은 괄호 안에 넣어라.

easy: A clear liquid used to clean cuts and to bleach things.

ex.en: Mom cleaned my scraped knee with peroxide.
ex.ko: 엄마가 까진 내 무릎을 과산화수소로 소독해 주셨다.

easy: To make hair lighter using peroxide.

ex.en: My aunt peroxided her hair until it was almost white.
ex.ko: 이모는 머리를 거의 하얗게 될 때까지 탈색했다.

easy: Done after someone has finished a doctor's degree (PhD).

ex.en: My aunt is doing postdoctoral research on whales.
ex.ko: 이모는 고래에 관한 박사 후 연구를 하고 있다.

easy: Known from a proverb or a famous saying.

ex.en: Finding my ring in the sand was like finding the proverbial needle in a haystack.
ex.ko: 모래 속에서 반지를 찾는 건 속담처럼 건초 더미에서 바늘 찾기 같았다.

easy: A strange habit or way of acting.

ex.en: One of my dog's quirks is sleeping upside down.
ex.ko: 우리 개의 별난 버릇 하나는 뒤집어져서 자는 것이다.

easy: A person who works to change things to make them better.

ex.en: The reformer fought for every child to go to school.
ex.ko: 그 개혁가는 모든 아이가 학교에 다닐 수 있도록 힘썼다.

easy: Having to do with the retina, the back part inside your eye that senses light.

ex.en: The eye doctor took a retinal photo of my eye.
ex.ko: 안과 의사가 내 눈의 망막 사진을 찍었다.

easy: A person who tricks people to take their money.

ex.en: The scammer sent a fake email asking for Grandma's password.
ex.ko: 사기꾼이 할머니의 비밀번호를 달라는 가짜 이메일을 보냈다.

easy: A small, fluffy herding dog that looks like a little collie.

ex.en: Our Shetland tries to herd the kids like sheep.
ex.ko: 우리 셸티는 아이들을 양처럼 몰려고 한다.

easy: A person or company that sends goods to other places.

ex.en: The shipper sent the boxes by train.
ex.ko: 발송인은 상자들을 기차로 보냈다.

easy: To make a hissing sound like food frying in hot oil.

ex.en: The bacon sizzled in the pan.
ex.ko: 베이컨이 프라이팬에서 지글지글 소리를 냈다.

easy: The hissing sound food makes when it fries.

ex.en: I love the sizzle of pancakes on the griddle.
ex.ko: 나는 번철 위에서 팬케이크가 지글거리는 소리가 좋다.

easy: A raised, covered walkway between two buildings.

ex.en: We crossed the skywalk from the hotel to the mall.
ex.ko: 우리는 공중 보행로를 건너 호텔에서 쇼핑몰로 갔다.

easy: A piece of music in three or four parts, often for piano.

ex.en: My sister played a short sonata at her piano recital.
ex.ko: 언니는 피아노 발표회에서 짧은 소나타를 연주했다.

easy: Full of deep feeling.

ex.en: The puppy looked at me with soulful eyes.
ex.ko: 강아지가 애틋한 눈빛으로 나를 바라보았다.

easy: To make a lot of animals run away in panic.

ex.en: The thunder stampeded the cattle across the field.
ex.ko: 천둥 때문에 소 떼가 놀라 들판을 가로질러 우르르 달아났다.

easy: A sudden rush of a crowd of people all at once.

ex.en: When the bell rang, there was a stampede to the playground.
ex.ko: 종이 울리자 아이들이 운동장으로 우르르 몰려갔다.

easy: The end of a game when both sides have the same score.

ex.en: The chess game ended in a standoff.
ex.ko: 그 체스 경기는 무승부로 끝났다.

easy: Big, grand, and impressive.

ex.en: We toured a stately old mansion on the hill.
ex.ko: 우리는 언덕 위의 웅장한 옛 저택을 둘러보았다.

easy: Full of sugar.

ex.en: Sugary drinks are bad for your teeth.
ex.ko: 설탕이 든 음료는 이에 나쁘다.

easy: A star that blows up and shines super brightly.

ex.en: Long ago, people saw a supernova bright enough to see in the daytime.
ex.ko: 오래전 사람들은 낮에도 보일 만큼 밝은 초신성을 보았다.

easy: A sudden fit of anger, with crying or yelling.

ex.en: My little brother threw a tantrum when he couldn't have candy.
ex.ko: 남동생은 사탕을 못 먹게 되자 떼를 썼다.

easy: Having to do with the big moving pieces of the earth's crust.

ex.en: Earthquakes happen when tectonic plates move.
ex.ko: 지각판이 움직이면 지진이 일어난다.
